answer_1.quote: We address the problem of automatic open-domain dialogue evaluation by focusing on the quality of an entire dialogue... We assess its dialogue-level and turn-level judgement capability via correlation analysis on the human-chatbot conversational datasets.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue-level quality scores (and turn-level scores) for generated dialogues

answer_2.quote: We compare DynaEval against several recently proposed dialogue evaluators. The recently proposed reference-free state-of-the-art dialogue metrics, including USR, BERT-RUBER, GPT-2 based coherence metric and FED, serve as the baseline dialogue evaluators.

answer_4.quote: Human quality annotations of these conversations are performed at both the dialogue and turn level. There are 9 quality aspects for turn-level annotations and 11 for dialog-level annotations outlined in the first column of Table.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each dialogue on multiple predefined quality aspects (e.g., coherence, likability, consistency, diversity, topic depth, etc.) and each turn on aspects such as interestingness, engagement, specificity, relevance, etc.
